study: Vaughn et al. (2022), STRIVE comprehension/vocabulary PD for Grade-4 content literacy (ELs and non-ELs), J. Educ. Psychology
eval_evidence: IES-funded grant project (R305A150407, STRIVE) conducted and authored by the Vaughn/Swanson Meadows Center research team who developed the STRIVE PD and the content/comprehension measures (Swanson et al. 2018). Developer-conducted, not an independent third-party evaluator.
developer_evidence: All teachers attended an initial PD session delivered by the research team; in the RPD arm the research team also led the follow-up study groups. The developing research team delivered the PD (RPD directly; SPD via a school educator the team trained).
cascade_evidence: MIXED across the two pooled arms: RPD = research team supports teachers directly (developer_direct); SPD = the PD model is handed to 'a key educator in the school' who then leads the follow-up study groups (a train-the-trainer/lead-educator hop). Because STRIVE pools RPD+SPD, the combined study includes a cascade arm -> coded cascade (RPD-only would be developer_direct).
counterfactual_evidence: Third arm was 'business-as-usual (BAU)' — control schools continued usual Grade-4 social-studies/literacy instruction with no STRIVE PD. Standard BAU contrast (STRIVE = pooled RPD+SPD vs BAU).
coaching_evidence: PD model = an initial PD session before the school year plus 'teacher study groups' (group follow-up PD) across the 18-week / three-unit period; RPD vs SPD differs only in WHO leads the follow-up (research team vs a school educator), not in coaching cadence. No ongoing in-class coaching/observation-feedback cycles for teachers described (audio-recording of lessons was for fidelity measurement only) -> none.
student_dose_evidence: STRIVE changes the teacher's regular content-area (social studies) literacy instruction — comprehension and vocabulary practices in normal lessons. No tutoring, pull-out, extra minutes, or student-facing software dose added.
maturity_evidence: Each of three cohorts is a fresh set of schools/teachers participating for a single year (PD before the school year, then ~18 weeks / three units of implementation); outcomes measured at the end of that first implementation year, teachers new to STRIVE -> first_year.
